name: SkyBrief
author: tecknozic
description: Aviation weather for the Omarchy bar: METAR, TAF and flight category at a glance, decoded or raw, with optional NOTAMs through an autorouter account.

barWidget.description: Flight category pill with METAR, TAF and NOTAM details

schema.label: Favourite station
schema.description: ICAO code. Empty picks the nearest reporting field from the Omarchy weather location.

schema.label: Quick list
schema.description: Comma-separated ICAO codes offered in the panel. Ten at most; extra codes are ignored.

schema.label: Favourite FIR
schema.description: FIR identifier (e.g. LFFF) whose NOTAMs are shown alongside the aerodrome's.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Applies to temperature, visibility and altimeter only. Wind stays in knots, cloud base in feet.

schema.label: Earlier observations kept
schema.description: How many past observations the trend unfolds. 0 hides the trend entirely.

schema.label: NOTAM source
schema.description: autorouter requires an account with API access and credentials saved from the detail view.
